name: mast_solenoid_row_share_from_inputs_only
author: first_agent
question: Do the MAST inputs alone (coil currents, Ip, Thomson) support the solenoid row share 0.5 that was set on the three demo shots' EFIT fields before rule 3, or the series reading 1.0, or neither?
rule_3: MAST inputs and our own maps only; no MAST equilibrium field, demo shot or leaderboard number is read. The existing constant's provenance (demo-shot EFIT, 21 Sep) is disclosed in docs/final_phase/DATA_PROVENANCE.md; this test does not use it.
feasibility_before_freeze: shots 301 and 603, one mid frame each (inputs + house solve only): solenoid vacuum flux difference between R 0.25 and 1.40 m at the laser height at share 0.5 = -0.0157 and -0.0074 Wb/rad; the house solve's pair tolerance 0.02*span = 0.0016/0.0017 -> the equal-temperature pairs are sensitive to the share.
arms: share in {0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0}: the v7 entrypoint copy (../v8/entrypoints_v7_copy) unchanged; after predict_mast.read_shot the solenoid filaments' currents (coil column magnetics_sol_current) are multiplied by share/0.5. Arm 0.5 must reproduce ../v8/pilot/rows_v7.json (parity gate: identical solved flags and pair gaps to 1e-9, else stop).
pilot: the M3b harness: 41 public MAST shots, indices 0, 30, ..., 1200, all frames; Pool(4), nice.
metrics: per frame on the final maps (organisers' reading): normalised-flux gap |x_out - x_in| of the equal-Te pairs at Te shares .85/.5/.25/.10/.05; solved flag. Primary per frame: mean gap over the shares present. Frames used for the comparison: live and solved in all four arms.

decision_rule.statistic: per shot the median primary; arm score = median over shots; paired shot bootstrap (20000, seed 931) of the difference between two arms
decision_rule.supports_0.5: arm 0.5 has the lowest score and P(0.5 lower than 1.0) >= 0.9 and P(0.5 lower than each of 0.25, 0.75) >= 0.8
decision_rule.supports_1.0: arm 1.0 has the lowest score and P(1.0 lower than 0.5) >= 0.9
decision_rule.guard: an arm whose solved share is lower than arm 0.5's by more than 0.10 cannot be 'supported'

diagnostics_not_deciding: the same statistics on frames in the upper half of |solenoid current|; per-share gaps; solved shares.
consequences: supports_0.5 -> the constant is corroborated by inputs alone; recorded for the entrant's clean-room decision (FINAL_PHASE_REQUIREMENTS 3.1). supports_1.0 -> recorded; no MAST submission changes without the entrant (a new build and the M2-type criterion would be needed). inconclusive -> recorded; the constant's only basis stays the disclosed demo-shot fit.
resources: CPU WS, 4 workers, one arm at a time (~20-40 min each).
